description: This file defines the AppRoot widget, a StatelessWidget that sets up multiple providers (AuthProvider and AttendanceProvider) for state management in a Flutter application. It wraps the main AttendanceApp widget with these providers to make state accessible throughout the app.

classes.name: AppRoot
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides global state management for authentication and attendance data, and builds the main attendance application widget.

methods.description: Constructor for the AppRoot widget, with optional key parameter.
